artworks.title: Miss May Belfort, Large Plate (Miss May Belfort, grande planche)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's upper body in profile facing left. The person's facial features are visible, including a nose and lips, and their hair is styled back. They are wearing an intricate garment with soft, flowing lines resembling a gown or robe with puffed sleeves. The background is minimal and lightly sketched, with a faint horizontal line near the lower part of the drawing.

artworks.title: Miss May Belfort in the Irish and American Bar, rue Royale (Miss Belfort Belfort au Irish and American Bar, Rue Royale)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of a woman from the waist up, in profile facing right. She appears slightly turned to the side, with her head, shoulders, pronounced nose, subtle lips, and dark curly hair visible. She wears a hat with a tall plume or decoration and an elegant coat or wrap with large collars or ruffles. Faint outlines of other figures, including someone in a top hat, are around her. The background is minimally defined to keep the focus on the woman and her attire.

artworks.title: Luce Myres in Profile (Luce Myrès, de profil)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a woman, shown from the waist up in a side view. She is seated facing to the right. Her facial features are delicately drawn with a calm expression. She has short, wavy hair with a large bow at the back. She wears a high-necked garment with loose, flowing sleeves. She is holding an object, possibly a fan, in her hands. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Luce Myres Full Face (Luce Myrès, de face)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person depicted from the waist up, standing in an upright position. The person's facial features are delicately drawn, with closed eyes and prominent lips. Their hair appears wavy and is adorned with a flower on one side. The individual is wearing a dress with large, puffed sleeves and a high collar. They are holding a large fan in one hand, which is partially open. The background consists of simple lines and shading. The drawing is signed "Flautree" in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Luce Myres Full Face (Luce Myrès, de face)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with her head slightly tilted upwards, eyes closed, and a serene expression on her face. She has curly hair with a floral hair accessory on the left side of her head. She is wearing a gown with puffed sleeves and a high collar, and holding a folding fan in her right hand. The background has vertical lines suggesting a curtain or textured wall behind her.

artworks.title: Adieu
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person facing a body of water. The person is shown from behind, holding a thin object in one hand. They are wearing a high-collared dress with long sleeves and a long skirt, along with a hat adorned with a feather or embellishment. The person's hair is neatly styled under the hat, and no facial features are visible. A dog is depicted standing next to the person, looking towards the water. In the background, there are outlines of sailboats on the water, a crescent moon in the sky, and buildings that resemble docks or industrial structures. The sketch is done in soft, grayscale tones.

artworks.title: Ballade de Noël
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a semi-crouched position, moving forward. The person has short, curly hair and their facial features are emphasized, particularly the eyes. They are wearing loose-fitting clothing, including a long-sleeved top and pants, along with shoes with pointed tips. The person is carrying a bundle of sticks on their back with a strap over their shoulder. The background shows a lightly sketched outdoor environment with buildings and a streetlamp visible among abstract lines.

artworks.title: Ce que dit la pluie
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a windy scene with a figure holding an umbrella being blown by the wind. The lines suggest motion, with the skirt of the figure and the umbrella caught in the gusts. A small dog is also present, bracing against the wind. The composition conveys movement and blustery weather, with a light and impressionistic style capturing the essence of the scene with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Le Fou
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man from the waist up in a three-quarter profile. He has distinct features, including a pointed nose and a spiky hairstyle, suggesting short, unruly hair. The man is wearing a long coat and has his arms crossed in front of his chest. In the background, there is a faint outline of a building facade with vertical elements. Another figure, drawn in profile view with a hat, is walking away on the left side. The background is minimalistic.

artworks.title: Les papillons
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring butterflies and a ship in the background. The central focus is a detailed large butterfly in the foreground. In the background, a ship with masts and smokestack is depicted. Smaller butterflies are also shown fluttering around the large butterfly. The drawing has a minimalist style with precise lines and shading, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: L'hareng saur
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body sketch of a person standing sideways. The person is facing left, with one hand near their chin or mouth and the other resting by their side. They are wearing a sailor's cap, a loose-fitting shirt, rolled-up pants, and are barefoot. The background shows the outline of a ship with ropes and a mast.

artworks.title: Le secret
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an elderly person sitting in a wooden chair. They are seated in a relaxed position, facing slightly to the left. The facial features are softly defined, with minimal detail on the face, and the head covered by a hat or bonnet. The person is wrapped in a long garment, holding a walking stick with both hands placed on top. A small cat is sitting on the floor nearby, looking up at the person. In the background, there is a fireplace or stove with hanging utensils or dried herbs. The sketch is executed in fine pencil, giving a soft, textured appearance.

artworks.title: Etoiles filantes
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing next to each other. One person has their arm around the other. The person on the left is hunched slightly forward, with their face obscured by shadow and long hair. The person on the right is looking upward, with a partially visible face and shorter hair. Both individuals are wearing loose garments. Ironwork decorates the surroundings, possibly a balcony railing. The background features a night sky, a full moon, and a shooting star.

artworks.title: Oceano Nox
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person on the deck of a sailboat. The scene captures the silhouette of a figure poised on the bowsprit, with several sails unfurled above and around them. The drawing is rendered in delicate pencil strokes, using shading techniques to suggest the texture of the sails and the swirling movement of the water below. The composition draws attention to the dynamic posture of the figure, balanced against the sweeping lines of the sails and rigging. The overall atmosphere evokes a sense of movement and adventure, as the vessel navigates through a seemingly calm expanse of water.

artworks.title: Les hirondelles de mer
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sailboat from a lower perspective, suggesting movement on water. The boat is depicted against flowing lines indicating waves without showing the horizon. The sketch is done in a loose, dynamic style using charcoal or pencil on beige paper, creating a monochromatic look with black lines. Details show the water's texture and the boat's side, with the sail indicating depth and direction.

artworks.title: Floréal
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The sketch shows the upper body of two people depicted in a side view, walking together. The woman on the left has curly hair styled up. The man is slightly bent towards her and wearing a brimmed straw hat. Both figures are dressed in knee-length casual outdoor clothing; the woman in a loose dress and the man in a jacket and shorts. The woman has puffed sleeves, and the man has visible knee-length socks. There is a loosely sketched bicycle leaning against a tree in the background, and the environment indicates an outdoor setting without detailed scenery.

artworks.title: Achetez mes belles violettes
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a woman from the waist up. She is leaning slightly forward, showing her facial features and short, curled hair. She is wearing a high-collared top, possibly a blouse or a jacket, with a textured fabric like silk or satin. She has a dark scarf around her neck and is holding a basket with indistinct objects. In the background, there are outlines resembling a wheel and shapes reminiscent of a carriage or vehicle, along with sparse surroundings that may suggest buildings or structures.

artworks.title: Les vieux papillons
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up. The person on the left is hunched over, with a bald head and a prominent nose. Their facial features are round with bushy eyebrows, sparse hair and a posture indicating focus on the other figure. The person on the right is facing slightly away, with a youthful profile, curly hair, sharp facial features, and a head turned sideways. Both are dressed in dark clothing and seated at a table. Above them is a sketch of a butterfly.

artworks.title: La valse des lapins
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image is a lithographic print featuring rabbits. One rabbit is eating vegetation, while another larger rabbit sits alert facing to the right. In the background, there is a smaller rabbit near a fence. The horizon line shows a fence and a tree silhouette with a moon. The style consists of sketchy linework with a monochromatic color palette of primarily grey and black. The title "la Valse des lapins" is written at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Prospectus Programme de l'Oeuvre
artworks.artist: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, Félix Vallotton, Antonio de la Gandara, M. Doudelet, Maurice Denis, and Edouard Vuillard
artworks.medium: one sheet folded in thirds with text and text insert, and 6 prints: Cover in lithograph by Toulouse-Lautrec, 1 woodcut by Charles Doudelet, 1 woodcut or woodengraving by Denis, 1 woodcut by Vallotton, 1 lithograph by Vuillard, and 1 lithograph byAntonio de la Gandara
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective from a ship's deck looking out towards the ocean. The horizon is high in the top of the image with the sky meeting the water. There are faint outlines of ship rigging and masts. The drawing uses soft pencil strokes, creating a blurred and textured appearance. It is rendered in monochrome with shades of grey and black. Closest to the viewer, the ship's railing and deck elements are visible, including a lifebuoy. In the distance, figures interact with the ship's navigational instruments. The text "L'OEUVRE" and "Paris, 23 rue Turgot" are included in the image.

artworks.title: Sarah Bernhardt in "Cleopatra" (Sarah Bernhardt dans "Cléopatre")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image is a sketch featuring an upper body view of a person facing forward. The individual's head and shoulders are the main focus. The face is depicted with simple lines, including arched eyebrows and outlined eyes. The lips are in a neutral position. The hair is shown as wavy locks. The person is wearing loose garments, and there is a classical column in the background. The clothing and setting are stylized with broad strokes and flowing forms.

artworks.title: Sarah Bernhardt in "Cleopatra" (Sarah Bernhardt dans "Cléopatre")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on China paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract sketch of a person, focusing on the upper chest to above the head. The style merges the figure with its surroundings. The person's head is positioned slightly backward or looking upwards. Facial features are faint yet expressive with arched eyebrows, subtle eyes, and mouth outlines. The hair is depicted with loose curls around the head. The individual is draped in a flowing garment that blends with surrounding lines and shapes. In the background, there is a column on the left and a triangular shape on the right. The artwork is created in a monochrome palette, likely charcoal or pencil.

artworks.title: Subra of the Opera? (Subra, de l'opéra?)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up, depicted in profile with their head turned upwards to the right. The person has a pointed nose, closed lips, and focused eyes. Their hair is styled back in a bun or updo. The clothing is draped over one shoulder. Around them are sketch lines suggesting a column with carvings and a distant landscape or arch-like structure. The background includes architectural elements, adding depth to the image with minimal details focused on line work.

artworks.title: Cléo de Mérode
artworks.medium: lithograph on brown laid paper [trial proof?]
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the back and side, focusing on her upper body. She is seated with her head turned slightly to the right, revealing her profile. Her facial features include a delicate nose and full lips in profile. She has voluminous hair styled in waves or curls, and wears what appears to be a fur coat enveloping her shoulders and upper arms. In the background, there are faint, soft lines suggesting two other figures in an interior scene. The drawing has a monochromatic, sepia-toned appearance.
